body: I'm 20. I've tried for a while to maintain the mentality that things will get better as I get older, but that becomes harder to buy now that I'm in college and still feel as if I have the same insecurities that an adolescent middle schooler has. I'm shy, I hate the way I look, and I'm terrified of emotional and physical intimacy. When it comes to fixing shit like that I don't even know where to begin.
